title: WINDSHIELD WASHER HOSES & JAR
summary: Windshield washer jar (washer fluid bottle / reservoir) and hoses, all models. The jar [6] is screwed with screws [10] to bracket [7], which is riveted [8] to the fender skirt in the engine compartment; hose & filter [5] sits in the jar under cap [9], hose [4] feeds the washer pump on the wiper motor (View A), and the RH [1] and LH [2] hoses run along the top of the dash plenum through grommets [3] and clips to the wiper arms. The jar is filled with washer solvent (143a).

fastening.note: View B: screw [10] goes through the ear on the side of the jar [6] into bracket [7].
View B / main view: bracket [7] riveted to the skirt with rivets [8].
Hose & filter [5] drops into the jar neck; cap [9] closes the neck.

fastening.to: jar [6] outlet and washer pump on wiper motor
fastening.note: Hose [4] runs from the jar along the engine wiring clips (UPC 12) to the pump on the wiper motor (View A).
Hoses [1] and [2] go from the pump nipples (View A) along the top of the dash plenum through grommets [3] to the wiper arms; RH hose passes between the door control switch and the wiper transmission.

notes: Route the windshield washer hoses along the top surface of the dash plenum, through the clip to each wiper arm; the RH hose passes between the door control switch and the wiper transmission.
